title: Ranunculus
summary: RANUN'CULUS, noun [Latin from rana, a frog.] In botany, crowfoot, a genus of plants of many species, some of them beautiful flowering plants, particularly the Asiatic, or Turkey and Persian ranunculus

inlines.v: RANUN'CULUS, noun [Latin from rana, a frog.] In botany, crowfoot, a genus of plants of many species, some of them beautiful flowering plants, particularly the Asiatic, or Turkey and Persian ranunculus which is diversified with many rich colors.
